Après Gravel (Philly Gravel Club)

Philadelphia, PA · East Falls / Wissahickon · Gravel

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Après Gravel (Philly Gravel Club) is a gravel group ride in Philadelphia, PA. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Gustine Lake Recreation Center. Pace: moderate, no-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: moderate, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @phillygravelclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Après Gravel (Philly Gravel Club) group ride

A fixed gravel loop through the Wissahickon every Monday evening. Beginner friendly and a little goofy on purpose. No drop. The club also runs a Sunday Funday gravel ride on alternate Sundays for intermediate riders.
